root_cause.text: On PREEMPT_RT kernels, preemption between rt6_get_pcpu_route() returning NULL and the subsequent cmpxchg() in rt6_make_pcpu_route() allows another task on the same CPU to install a per-CPU route, causing the cmpxchg to fail and trigger a BUG_ON that assumed atomicity.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message states: "On PREEMPT_RT kernels, after rt6_get_pcpu_route() returns NULL, the current task can be preempted. Another task ... may then execute rt6_make_pcpu_route() and successfully install a pcpu_rt entry. When the first task resumes execution, its cmpxchg() ... will fail because rt6i_pcpu is no longer NULL, triggering the BUG_ON(prev)." The patch replaces the BUG_ON with a graceful fallback that handles the race.
